source.text: 6.5 If delivery is delayed beyond the Delivery Deadline, the first four (4) calendar days of delay shall not attract a late-delivery penalty. From the next day, a penalty of 2.5% of the value of the delayed Equipment shown on the relevant Invoice shall apply for each day of delay, subject to an aggregate ceiling of 15% of that Invoice value.

deadline_source.text: 6.2 For Orders governed by this Agreement, the required delivery date is 28 February 2027 (the “Delivery Deadline”), unless a later or different date is expressly agreed in a written amendment signed by both Parties.
